title: What Is a Low-k Dielectric in Semiconductors? Why the Space Between Wires Is Made Airy
excerpt: What is a low-k dielectric in semiconductors? A beginner-friendly guide based on primary sources, covering the link between wiring capacitance and dielectric constant, the shift from glass to fluorine-doped, carbon-doped, and porous materials, weaknesses like fragility and moisture, and air gaps.
